import pygame
import random

# Initialize Pygame
pygame.init()

# Set up some constants
WIDTH, HEIGHT = 640, 480
PLAYER_SIZE = 50
ENEMY_SIZE = 50
BULLET_SIZE = 10

# Set up some colors
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
RED = (255, 0, 0)
GREEN = (0, 255, 0)

# Set up the display
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))

# Set up the fonts
font = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)

# Set up the player
class Player:
    def __init__(self):
        self.x = WIDTH / 2
        self.y = HEIGHT / 2
        self.speed = 5

    def move(self, keys):
        if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
            self.y -= self.speed
        if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
            self.y += self.speed
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
            self.x -= self.speed
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
            self.x += self.speed

# Set up the enemies
class Enemy:
    def __init__(self):
        self.x = random.randint(0, WIDTH)
        self.y = random.randint(0, HEIGHT)
        self.speed = 2

    def move(self):
        self.x += random.randint(-self.speed, self.speed)
        self.y += random.randint(-self.speed, self.speed)
        if self.x < 0 or self.x > WIDTH:
            self.x = max(0, min(self.x, WIDTH))
        if self.y < 0 or self.y > HEIGHT:
            self.y = max(0, min(self.y, HEIGHT))

class Bullet:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
        self.speed = 10

    def move(self):
        self.y -= self.speed

                    bullets.append(Bullet(player.x, player.y))

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.move(keys)

        for enemy in enemies:
            enemy.move()

        for bullet in bullets:
            bullet.move()
            if bullet.y < 0:
                bullets.remove(bullet)

        screen.fill((0, 0, 0))
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (player.x, player.y, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE))
        for enemy in enemies:
            pygame.draw.rect(screen, RED, (enemy.x, enemy.y, ENEMY_SIZE, ENEMY_SIZE))

game_loop()
